name: Zephyr
description: Let agents read test cases, test cycles and test results in Zephyr (Zephyr Scale for Jira Cloud), and record test results. For running regression cycles and triaging failures into Jira defects.
identity: A Zephyr API access token. It acts as the Jira user who created it, with that user's access to Jira projects, so create it as a user made for agents.

setup.title: Create a Jira user for agents
setup.body: Zephyr tokens belong to the Jira user who creates them and reach every project that user can see. Make a user for agents and give it access only to the projects whose tests agents should read or run.
click: In Atlassian Administration, invite a user named AI agents and give it Jira access.
In each Jira project agents should work in, add AI agents to a role that can browse the project.

setup.title: Create a Zephyr API access token
setup.body: Sign in to Jira as the agents' user and create the token. Zephyr shows it only once. You can test it with the command below: it lists your Zephyr projects and changes nothing.
click: In Jira, select your profile picture at the bottom left, then Zephyr API keys.
Create an access token and copy it.

fields.label: API address
fields.help: api.zephyrscale.smartbear.com, or for data kept in another region eu.api.zephyrscale.smartbear.com, au.api.zephyrscale.smartbear.com or de.api.zephyrscale.smartbear.com.

capabilities.label: Read tests and results
capabilities.description: List a project's test cases, test cycles and test executions, filtered by cycle, test case or Jira version, and the status names behind their status ids.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches every project the token's user can see unless you keep a key to chosen projects.

capabilities.label: Record test results
capabilities.description: Record the result of running a test case in a test cycle, such as Pass or Fail, with a comment.

limits.label: Jira projects
limits.help: Optional: only these Jira projects, by key, such as QA. Leave empty for every project the token's user can see.

revoke: Sign in to Jira as the agents' user, select the profile picture, then Zephyr API keys, and delete the token. Agents lose access to Zephyr at once.

tools.name: zephyr_list_test_cases
tools.description: List a project's test cases. Pass start_at to read further pages; isLast in the answer says whether there are more.

folder_id.description: Only test cases in this folder
folder_id.name: folderId

tools.name: zephyr_list_test_cycles
tools.description: List a project's test cycles, optionally for one Jira version. Pass start_at to read further pages.

jira_version_id.description: Only cycles for this Jira version (release) id
jira_version_id.name: jiraProjectVersionId

tools.name: zephyr_list_test_executions
tools.description: List test results, filtered by test cycle, test case or Jira version, such as every failure in a regression cycle. Pass start_at to read further pages.

test_cycle.description: Only this test cycle, by key such as QA-R12
test_cycle.name: testCycle

test_case.description: Only this test case, by key such as QA-T40
test_case.name: testCase

only_last.description: Only the latest result of each test case
only_last.name: onlyLastExecutions

tools.name: zephyr_list_statuses
tools.description: List a project's statuses with their ids and names, such as Pass and Fail for test executions, to read the status ids in other answers.

tools.name: zephyr_create_test_execution
tools.description: Record a test result: a test case run in a test cycle, with its status name, such as Pass or Fail, and a comment.

test_case_key.description: The test case key, such as QA-T40
test_case_key.name: testCaseKey

test_cycle_key.description: The test cycle key, such as QA-R12
test_cycle_key.name: testCycleKey

status_name.description: The result's status name in Zephyr, such as Pass, Fail or Blocked
status_name.name: statusName

comment.description: What happened, such as the failure seen

environment_name.description: The environment it ran in, as named in Zephyr
environment_name.name: environmentName
